title: Hearty Flaky Syrian Lamb Pilaf
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring lamb, dill, and a flaky crust, perfect for a hearty dinner, this recipe is also FODMAP friendly and incorporates a bain-marie for even cooking.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the lamb until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped dill, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and cook for an additional minute.
In a separate saucepan, bring 4 cups of water to a boil, then add the basmati rice and reduce heat to low, covering the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and 1 tablespoon of water, then brush the mixture onto the phyllo dough.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with the lemon juice mixture.
Add the cooked lamb and rice mixture to the baking dish, then top with additional phyllo dough layers.
Place the baking dish into a larger dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides, creating a bain-marie.
Bake the pilaf for 30 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the pilaf from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
